playbook.title: Gap fade
playbook.rule: Fade a gap ≥0.75 ATR once price reclaims back toward the prior close; stop beyond the extreme of the open.

playbook.title: VWAP pullback
playbook.rule: After the stock has moved ≥0.6 ATR from the open and held the correct side of VWAP ~80% of the morning, fade the first touch back to VWAP. Exit on a close back through VWAP.

playbook.title: First-hour range breakout
playbook.rule: After 10:30 ET, if the open→10:30 move is ≥0.7 ATR, trade the first break of the morning high/low in that direction. Stop 0.15 ATR; target 2R.
